name: Belongs To Account
description: A resource is owned by an AWS account other than the one it was collected from (resource -> account): the account the collector reads from the item's owner field (OwnerId, OwnerAccountId, ownerAccount) when it differs from the collecting account, which is the case for a resource shared in through AWS RAM. A resource the collecting account owns carries that account as its `aws_account` dimension and has no edge (aws-core-tap#81, req-aws-core-account-dimension). The sources are listed so a type that can be owned from elsewhere is added on purpose. A reference, not containment: a resource shared through AWS RAM is used from other accounts, and an account's subtree can exceed the cascade cap. The `_TO` is the locative preposition of 'belongs to'. Excluded: region, availability zone, account, the Organizations types (their placement is NESTED_UNDER_PARENT) and Bedrock foundation models, which AWS owns.
